sn16.13:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn16.13:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam adhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn16.13:1.4: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena pubbe appatarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṃ || bahutarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahiṃsu || ||
sn16.13:1.5: Ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yenetarahi bahutarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantīti || || 4
sn16.13:1.6: Evañhetaṃ Kassapa hoti || sattesu hāyamānesu saddhamme antaradhāyamāne bahutarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni honti || appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahanti || || 5
sn16.13:1.7: Na tāva Kassapa saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti yāva na saddhammapaṭirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati ||
sn16.13:1.8: yato ca kho Kassapa saddhammapaṭirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati atha saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti || || 6
sn16.13:2.1: Seyyathāpi Kassapa na tāva jātarūpassa antaradhānaṃ hoti yāva na jātarūpapatirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati ||
sn16.13:2.2: yato ca kho Kassapa jātarūpapaṭirūpakam loke uppajjati atha jātarūpassa antaradhānaṃ hoti || || 7
sn16.13:2.3: Evam eva kho Kassapa na tāva saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti yāva na saddhammapatirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati ||
sn16.13:2.4: yato ca kho Kassapa saddhammapatirūpakam loke uppajjati atha saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti || || 8-11
sn16.13:3.1: Na kho Kassapa pathavīdhātu saddhammam antaradhāpeti || nā āpodhātu || pe|| na tejodhātu || pe|| || na vayodhātu saddhammam antaradhāpeti || || 12
sn16.13:3.2: Atha kho idheva te uppajjanti moghapurisā ye imaṃ saddhammaṃ antaradhāpenti || || 13
sn16.13:3.4: na kho Kassapa evaṃ saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti || || 14
sn16.13:4.1: Pañca kho me Kassapa okkamaniyā dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti || ||
sn16.13:4.3: Idha Kassapa bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appaṭissā || dhamme agāravā viharanti appaṭissā || saṅghe agāravā viharanti appaṭissā || sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appaṭissā || samādhismiṃ agāravā viharanti appaṭissā || ||
sn16.13:4.4: Ime kho Kassapa pañca okkamaniyā dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti || || 16
sn16.13:5.1: Pañca kho me Kassapa dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti || ||
sn16.13:5.3: Idha Kassapa bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari sagāravā viharanti sappaṭissā || dhamme sagāravā viharanti sappaṭissā || saṅghe sagāravā viharanti sappaṭissā || sikkhāya sagāravā viharanti sappaṭissā || samādhismiṃ sagāravā viharanti sappaṭissā || || 18
sn16.13:5.4: Ime kho Kassapa pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
